---
title: Code wrap
---

A soft-wrapped block with no title floats its copy button over the code.

```bash wrap
echo "This single long line should soft-wrap because the fence carries the wrap modifier" && export WRAP_MARKER_TOKEN=abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
```
